title: cloud cost_usd includes the factory's own jev rows, unnamed in the line's basis
body:
The factory's /jev route stamps the run's full gatewayMetadata on the classifier's calls, so the run-scoped cost sync (rows summed by run_id) folds the classifier's measured spend into the run's cost_usd. The cloud workers-ai line renders that number over the worker attempts with the plain 'AI Gateway logs' basis, never naming the run-own money inside it — the same shape kf4 named for local runs, in the milder form where worker coverage is total. The basis (both renderers' wording, Go and status.ts, per rule 8) could name it, or the sync could separate it.
evidence: cloudflare/src/gateway.ts:1015 (the jev route stamps gatewayMetadata(token, run)); internal/statusmodel/cost.go cloud branch
